narrative: Material PL1__MF1AD0AD exhibits erratic demand (CV=1.14) with 63.2% non-zero working days and bursts up to 613 units/day. Lead times are moderately variable (CV=0.39, range 0.06-4.96 days), contributing 23.5% of total lead-time demand variance while demand variability dominates at 76.5%. The current SAP safety stock of 70 units is critically insufficient for a 95% service level, which requires 623 units based on combined demand-lead-time variance. A continuous-review (r,Q) policy with ROP=1,104 and OQ=890 is recommended, well within the 2,564-unit storage constraint.
warnings: SAP safety stock (70 units) is critically below the recommended 623 units — current policy likely yields service level well below 95%
High demand variability (CV=1.14) dominates risk; demand bursts may exceed buffer before replenishment arrives

research_insights.selection_rationale: Erratic demand with moderate lead-time variability is best managed by continuous-review reorder point triggering immediate replenishment upon stock depletion, combined with a fixed EOQ-derived batch size respecting the MOQ=327 constraint. The (r,Q) policy is preferred over periodic review for erratic materials as it avoids the additional exposure of a fixed review interval.
research_insights.boundary_risk: Moderate — demand variance dominates (76.5% of sigma_LTD); demand spikes above the 95th percentile (~575 units/day) arriving during peak lead-time periods could still cause stockouts. The safety stock provides 95% cycle service level but not full protection against clustered high-demand events.
research_insights.escalation_flag: none — MOQ (327) + safety stock (623) = 950 units, well within max_storage_units (2564.5). Capacity constraint is non-binding.
